controls.answer:
Markdown for Agents converts a site’s HTML into structured Markdown at Cloudflare’s edge, making content easier for AI systems to process while reducing token waste. Clients should send:

`Accept: text/markdown`

[Cloudflare Developer Docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/reference/markdown-for-agents/)

I'll start by opening the Cloudflare Developers homepage.
**Markdown for Agents** converts a page's HTML to Markdown at Cloudflare's edge, on the fly, when the zone has it enabled. Cloudflare fetches the original HTML from the origin and converts it "when possible," returning a predictable Markdown document (YAML frontmatter, body text with navigation/scripts/styles stripped, preserved JSON-LD) to reduce token waste. Clients request it via content negotiation by sending `Accept: text/markdown` (with `text/markdown` as one option); the response's `Content-Type` becomes `text/markdown; charset=utf-8`.

Source: https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/reference/markdown-for-agents/
